retirement_age.notes: Same for men and women. Under Law 1058-IV the age depends on the insurance record: 60 with at least 33 years (2026), 63 with 23 to 33 years, 65 with 15 to 23 years. The 60-year requirement rises to 34 years in 2027 and 35 years from 2028. Statutory is set to 65, the highest of the three tiers. Special rules apply to some groups (for example military service pensions).
